card.name: Comma after baseline-timing monitoring instructions
card.fires_on: Mainly a comma ending a clause about what to do before starting a drug (prior to initiating, before initiating), just ahead of a list of later monitoring times. Also a few linking words like 'the' after 'versus' or 'and' after 'throughout therapy'.

modes.label: Comma after pre-treatment step
modes.description: Comma following 'prior to initiating/therapy' or 'before initiating' that leads into follow-up monitoring or additional items.
modes.example: Monitor liver function prior to initiating LENVIMA<<,>> then every 2 weeks for the first

modes.label: Comma in graded or listed clauses
modes.description: Comma between parallel items such as severity grades or guideline-based instructions.
modes.example: Grade 1 is mild, Grade 2 is moderate, Grade 3 is serious<<,>> Grade 4 is life-threatening.

modes.label: Linking word in comparisons or durations
modes.description: A short linking word such as 'the' after 'versus' or 'and' after 'throughout therapy'.
modes.example: Consider the benefit of co-administration versus<< the>> potential risk of systemic corticosteroid
